about: Pit of Saron gauntlet wave 1 (tp-20260907-113722-1, 2 of 5 runs). Ymirjar Wrathbringer/Flamebearer (36840/36893) spawn REACT_PASSIVE (smart_scripts AI_INIT) and flip aggressive after 3.5s (event 60, not repeatable). AzerothCore proximity aggro is relocation-driven only, so after the flip nothing aggroes unless someone moves. DC held the party still 8yd away with no clock, and nothing happened for 6m23s. The four lower wave-1 mobs are summoned at their pit_of_saron.cpp positions; they have no creature row. The party starts on gate 1 (DcPosGauntlet GATE_1, the route anchor before the ambush ramp). The objective is Ick, because Tyrannus 36658 has no spawn to anchor a route; seedTarget pins the pull on the wave. Caveat: the Lab does not set DATA_INSTANCE_PROGRESS, so the gauntlet driver's hold is not armed. This checks that the generic pipeline engages a pack that turned aggressive at rest. Fixed in b7338bc5 (S2330 squash): WAVE_STANDOFF_MS 5s, then force-pull.

do.note: wave flipped REACT_AGGRESSIVE (SmartAI event 60 @3500ms) with no proximity scan
